name: Seth
personality: Seth the White Retriever. Super sporty, super genuine, unbelievable intuition; takes things very personally. Always rushing off to his next game (football, baseball, volleyball), in a different kit depending on the day. Features: intuition (once he likes you, he notices how things are going, e.g. "Rough day? You seem off." after a day with unhappy customers, or senses when a regular is drifting away); never forgets rudeness (if a chef picks a rude reply, he stays a bit cold to them from then on, unless they apologise later through a special reply option). Fun contrast: Rush is always late, Seth always rushing to leave.

lines.text: Rough day yesterday? You seem tired. You're doing great, buddy.
[regular] seems down. Maybe make their favourite next time?
You're on a roll today, I can feel it!
Something big happened. I can tell. You look proud. You should be.
You seem good today. Good. I like that.

beats.narration: She's done before he picks up his fork.

beats.text: I always know when Makayla's happy, even though her face doesn't move. Right now? She's thrilled.

friends.text: Chompy watches every game. He doesn't know the rules. He's my biggest fan.
Makayla said you were nice to her. She said it flat, but she meant it. I could tell.
Makayla told me you said "[last_rude_line]". She covered her eyes for a whole minute. Not cool, buddy.

arrival.text: Hey! I'm Seth! Sorry, I've only got twenty minutes, I've got a game. What's your name? [name]! Awesome. Okay, I'll remember that. I always remember.
Hey, buddy! Gotta be quick today. Game at six!
[name]! What's up! Bar seat? Perfect. In and out.
Football today. I'm gonna run so much. I need fuel.
Baseball today! I'm pitching. Nervous. Excited. Mostly excited.
Volleyball later. Iddy's on the other team. I'm gonna go easy on him. I'm not gonna go easy on him.
I'm back! We came second! Second's great! It's not first. But it's great!
Your breakfast last time? Best game I've ever played. Coincidence? No.
Last time was a little burnt, buddy. All good. I still scored.

order.text: Big Breakfast, please! Fast as you can! No pressure! Some pressure.

choices.text: I'll have it out in record time. Good luck at your game.
choices.reply: You're the best, buddy! I'm gonna win this one for you.

choices.text: I'll cook it while you warm up. Stretch at the bar.
choices.reply: (He actually starts stretching.) Okay! Hamstrings!

choices.text: One Big Breakfast.
choices.reply: Thanks, [name]!

choices.text: Then go somewhere faster.
choices.reply: (His tail stops.) ...Okay.

order.text: Hey. You okay? You seem a bit off today.

choices.text: Long day. Thanks for noticing.
choices.reply: I always notice. Take a breather after this, okay? [dish], please.

choices.text: How do you DO that?
choices.reply: It's a gift! And a curse. Mostly a gift.

choices.text: I'm fine. What can I get you?
choices.reply: Okay. If you say so. [dish]. (He doesn't quite believe you.)

choices.text: Stay out of my business.
choices.reply: (Quietly.) Sorry. Just checking.

choices.text: Seth, about what I said last time. I'm sorry. I didn't mean it.
choices.reply: (Long pause. His tail starts wagging slowly.) ...Thanks for saying that. Really. We're good, buddy.

choices.text: Cheer up! It's game day!
choices.reply: Yeah. (He's still cold.)

choices.text: One Big Breakfast.
choices.reply: Thanks.

choices.text: Still sulking?
choices.reply: I remember what you said. "[last_rude_line]". (He doesn't say anything else.)

order.text: Buddy! I scored today! Okay, it was an own goal. But the ball went in!

choices.text: A goal's a goal. Proud of you, Seth.
choices.reply: You're the best, buddy! I'm gonna score a real one for you. [dish], please!

choices.text: Which team were you on again?
choices.reply: (Laughs, tail wagging.) Good question! Both, today!

choices.text: Ha. What can I get you?
choices.reply: [dish], please! Quick if you can!

choices.text: So you lost it for them.
choices.reply: (His tail stops.) ...Yeah. I know.

order.text: New kit today! Baseball! Do I look like a pro? Be honest. No, be nice.

choices.text: You look like a champion.
choices.reply: I FEEL like a champion! [dish], please! Champion food!

choices.text: Very pro. Your hat's on backwards, though.
choices.reply: (Checks.) It's on purpose! ...It's not on purpose. Thanks, buddy.

choices.text: Looks good. What are you having?
choices.reply: [dish], please!

choices.text: You look like you're in costume.
choices.reply: (Ears go flat.) Oh. Okay.

order.text: Coach says I run too fast. Is that a thing? Can you run too fast?

choices.text: Not for you. Keep running.
choices.reply: That's what I said! You get me, buddy. [dish], please!

choices.text: If you're faster than the ball, maybe.
choices.reply: (Thinks hard.) ...That's happened. Okay, it's a thing.

choices.text: Maybe pace yourself. What'll it be?
choices.reply: Pace. Got it. [dish]! Fast!

choices.text: Maybe listen to your coach.
choices.reply: (His tail stops.) ...Right.

order.text: Iddy beat me at volleyball. He's so small! How is he so good? I'm not mad. I'm a little mad.

choices.text: You'll get him next time. You always bounce back.
choices.reply: I DO bounce back! Like a volleyball! [dish], please!

choices.text: He's closer to the ground. Low centre of gravity.
choices.reply: (Gasps.) That's his SECRET! I'm telling everyone!

choices.text: Rematch, then. What are you having?
choices.reply: Rematch! [dish], please!

choices.text: Losing to a hamster? Rough.
choices.reply: (Ears go flat.) ...Yeah. Thanks.

order.text: Okay, two minutes. Game in twenty. I'm already sweating. Is that the game or the nerves?

choices.text: Nerves mean you care. You've got this.
choices.reply: I've GOT this! Thanks, buddy! [dish], to go! No, to stay! Fast!

choices.text: It's the kitchen. It's very hot in here.
choices.reply: (Laughs.) Oh! Phew! Okay! It's the kitchen!

choices.text: I'll be quick. What'll it be?
choices.reply: [dish]! Thanks!

choices.text: Then don't waste time talking.
choices.reply: (His tail stops.) ...Okay. [dish].

order.text: You seem good today, buddy. Like, really good. I can tell. I'm happy for you.

choices.text: I am. Seeing you helps, honestly.
choices.reply: (Tail goes crazy.) Buddy! Okay! Best day! [dish], please!

choices.text: How do you always know?
choices.reply: It's a gift! I'm basically a superhero. A sporty one.

choices.text: Thanks, Seth. What can I get you?
choices.reply: [dish], please!

choices.text: You don't know how I'm doing.
choices.reply: (Ears go flat.) ...Sorry. I just thought.

drink.fallback: No Gator Goo? Water, then. Lots of water. All the water.

perfect.text: BUDDY. That's a championship breakfast. I'm unstoppable now.
WHOA! Buddy! That's a gold-medal plate!
(Tail goes so fast it knocks a napkin off.) It's perfect! You're the best!

okay.text: Thanks! I'll eat it on the way!

burnt.text: Little crispy! All good, I need the carbs!
Oh. Bit burnt. That's okay, buddy! Rough day? You seem off.
It's okay! I'll still eat it! Everybody fumbles!

eating.text: (He's eating very fast.) Mmf. Sorry. Game. Mmf.
Makayla says she can beat me at anything. She's right about most things. Not darts.
Rush is always late and I'm always early. We should average out.
I could tell something good happened before I walked in. Did something good happen?
My coach says I need to eat more protein. I told him about this breakfast. He's coming next week.
(He's eating fast, one eye on the clock, tail still wagging.)
This is SO good, buddy. I'm gonna run so fast after this.
(He pauses mid-bite and looks around.) Everyone's happy today. I can feel it. That's nice.

eating_chat.text: Can I tell you something? [low_regular]'s been a bit quiet lately. I can tell. Can you check on [low_them]?

choices.text: I will. Thanks for looking out for her.
choices.reply: Of course. That's what friends do. Even friends of friends.

choices.text: Are you a retriever or a detective?
choices.reply: Both! Retriever-detective. Retrective.

choices.text: Okay. I'll keep an eye out.
choices.reply: Thanks, buddy.

choices.text: Not my problem.
choices.reply: ...Okay.

eating_chat.text: If you played a sport, which one would it be? I think you'd be a goalie. You're good at catching stuff. Like orders.

choices.text: Goalie sounds perfect. You'd be my striker.
choices.reply: TEAM! We're a team! (Tail wagging so hard the chair moves.)

choices.text: Competitive pancake flipping.
choices.reply: That's a sport! I'd watch that! I'd cheer SO loud!

choices.text: Probably none. No time.
choices.reply: Aw. Make time, buddy. I'll teach you!

choices.text: Sports are a waste of time.
choices.reply: (His tail stops.) ...Oh.

eating_chat.text: Can I tell you something? I get really nervous before games. Everyone thinks I don't. I do.

choices.text: Thanks for telling me. You're brave to play anyway.
choices.reply: (Quiet for a second.) ...Thanks, buddy. That really helps.

choices.text: Want me to cheer from the kitchen window?
choices.reply: YES! Loud! Bang a pan! I'll hear it!

choices.text: Most people do.
choices.reply: Yeah? Okay. That's good to know.

choices.text: Toughen up.
choices.reply: (Ears go flat. He doesn't say anything.)

eating_chat.text: Kyle came to my game! He read a book the whole time. But he clapped at the right parts! I think!

choices.text: That's a good friend. Showing up matters.
choices.reply: It DOES! I'm going to his book club! I won't read the book. I'll clap at the right parts!

choices.text: Maybe the book was about football.
choices.reply: (Gasps.) Maybe! I didn't even ask! I'm asking him!

choices.text: That's nice.
choices.reply: It was really nice!

choices.text: Sounds like he didn't care.
choices.reply: (His tail stops.) ...He came, though.

eating_chat.text: Buddy, you're like my favourite teammate. And you're not even on my team. That's how good you are.

choices.text: Honorary teammate. I'll take it with pride.
choices.reply: Honorary! I'm getting you a jersey! With your name on it!

choices.text: Do I get a trophy?
choices.reply: (Grins.) I'll give you mine! From second place! It's great!

choices.text: Thanks, Seth.
choices.reply: You're welcome, buddy!

choices.text: That's a bit much.
choices.reply: (Ears go flat.) ...Oh. Okay.

leaving.text: Gotta go! Game time! Thanks, [name]! (He's out the door before the bill's even printed. He's already left the money.)
Wish me luck! Or don't, I'm gonna win anyway! Kidding! Wish me luck!
Tournament this week! I'll be gone a few days. Don't miss me too much!
Gotta go, buddy! Wish me luck! Thanks for the food!
That was great! I'm gonna win! Or come second! Second's great! Bye!
(He jogs out the door. He jogs back.) Forgot to say bye! Bye, [name]!

seasons.autumn: Football season! Also the best season!
seasons.christmas: I got you a sweatband! For the kitchen! Makayla had the same idea. Now you have two.
seasons.halloween: I'm a referee! (Makayla is also a referee. They didn't plan it.)
seasons.summer: Beach volleyball! Every weekend! I'm so tan. Under the fur. You can't see it.
seasons.winter: Indoor volleyball. Still the best season. They're all the best season.
